evt_algirdas_grand_duc: A pagan Lithuanian prince in furs and a pointed cap is acclaimed by armed nobles before a wooden hill fort in a snowy forest clearing.
evt_chute_de_tlemcen: A North African walled city of ochre towers is stormed by turbaned horsemen while its defenders retreat through the gate.
evt_desastre_de_kairouan: Arab and Berber horsemen in white robes and turbans are routed in front of the low walls of a desert city, banners fallen.
evt_dusan_prend_serres: A Serbian king in a crown and gold-brocaded robe rides in with his knights to receive the keys of a Byzantine walled town from kneeling Greek notables.
evt_election_d_osel_wiek: Clergy and canons in robes gather in a stone cathedral choir around a seated bishop-elect being invested with a crozier, Baltic coast town outside.
evt_faux_monnayeur: A coiner is caught in a back-street workshop with a tin-melting furnace and false coins on the table while bailiffs seize him, townsfolk watching.
evt_feu_de_grange: A great timber tithe barn burns fiercely at night while villagers pass leather buckets from a pond and flee with sacks of grain.
evt_jongleurs_de_passage: Travelling jugglers, a fiddler and a tumbler with a dancing dog perform in a medieval market square to a laughing crowd.
evt_loup_dans_la_bergerie: A grey wolf has slipped into a sheepfold at dusk, shepherds with staves and a dog run to drive it off while sheep scatter.
evt_marchand_detrousse: A merchant lies robbed beside his overturned cart on a forest road, his goods scattered, while bandits flee into the trees.
evt_mort_d_andronic_iii: A Byzantine emperor in a gold-and-purple robe lies dying on a bed in a palace chamber, surrounded by grieving courtiers and a patriarch.
evt_mort_d_ivan_kalita: A Russian prince in a fur-trimmed caftan lies on his deathbed in a timber palace hall with onion-domed churches seen through the window, boyars and monks at his side.
evt_mort_d_ozbeg: A Mongol khan in a felt cap and silk robe lies on cushions in a decorated yurt, nobles and shamans mourning around him.
evt_mort_de_gediminas: A Lithuanian grand duke in furs falls wounded beside his horse at the siege of a wooden castle, his warriors rushing to him.
evt_paix_de_kalisz: A Polish king and Teutonic Knights in white mantles with black crosses sign a peace treaty at a table in a hall, scribes and bishops witnessing.
evt_pelerins_malades: Sick pilgrims with staves and scallop shells rest and are tended by monks outside the gate of a hospice on a road.
evt_pont_effondre: The middle arch of a stone bridge has collapsed into a river, a cart and travellers falling into the water while onlookers on the banks cry out.
evt_prise_d_algesiras: Castilian knights with cross-marked banners enter a white Moorish port city by the sea after a long siege, ships and cannon in the bay.
evt_reliques_miraculeuses: Pilgrims kneel and the sick are healed before a gilded reliquary carried by priests in a village church, light falling from above.
evt_rixe_de_foire: A brawl breaks out at a fair, stalls overturned and merchants and peasants fighting with fists and stools while a bailiff rushes in.
evt_sainte_ligue_a_smyrne: Crusader knights and galleys of a Christian league storm the harbour fortress of a Turkish port city, ladders against the walls.
evt_seisme_de_gallipoli: An earthquake brings down towers and walls of a seaside city, people fleeing through rubble and dust, fissures in the ground.
evt_siege_de_caffa: Mongol horsemen and siege engines besiege a Genoese walled port on the Black Sea, galleys moored under its towers.
evt_source_guerisseuse: Villagers carry the sick to a holy spring under an old tree, a monk blessing the water as cripples are healed.
evt_tzympe: Ottoman warriors in turbans cross a narrow strait on rafts and land beneath a ruined Byzantine fortress at dawn.
evt_vente_de_l_estonie: A Danish king and the Teutonic Order's grand master exchange a sealed charter and a purse of gold on a table before a Baltic castle, clerks and knights looking on.
